content.text:
**Finding submitted: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement sits at the **preferred** position for rule LD — there is no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalty anywhere in the document:

| Area checked | Result |
|---|---|
| Fees / payment terms (Art. V, p0050–p0058, p0066–p0070, p0086) | Usage-based consideration only; no late-payment penalty or interest, no minimum-volume shortfall charge |
| Term & termination (Art. IV, p0049) | Licensor retains only accrued fees for trades actually performed — no acceleration of remaining contract value |
| Effect of termination (Art. XXI, p0138) | Return and certification of materials only; no exit or early-termination fee |
| Non-exclusive remedy (Art. XXIII, p0142) | Affirmatively bars termination damages both ways — favourable to us |

Two items I examined and deliberately did **not** flag, per the playbook's direction and minor-sub-element guidance:
- **Audit cost-shifting on a >5% discrepancy (p0064)** — reimbursement of actual audit cost, not a stipulated penalty sum.
- **33% "Supplemental Payments" revenue share (p0078)** — ongoing consideration, not a damages measure. Likewise the rebate shares in p0076 run *from* Licensor *to* us, which is compliant by direction.

Worth noting for other rules (outside LD's scope, and not flagged here to avoid double-counting): the liability cap in p0130 is one-sided in Licensor's favour and the indemnity in p0128–p0129 is Licensee-only — those belong to the limitation-of-liability and indemnity rules rather than this one.
